userDirection: A few more overflows into the centre, like the carrot fronds; do not overdo it.
prompt:
Make a very restrained local edit to this exact front book cover. The user likes the pale sage photographic strips and the way the existing carrot foliage overlaps the cream centre. Add just TWO small new, natural-looking overlaps from the TOP strip into the cream centre. Everything else should remain as it is.

1. At the far left, extend one modest sprig of authentic tomato foliage from the existing tomato cluster down across the straight top-strip/cream boundary. Only a couple of serrated tomato leaflets and a short connected stem should intrude, by roughly 6–9 mm of the cover height (about 35–55 pixels on this image). Keep this overlap in the open cream area at the extreme left, well to the left of 'The', and above the big V. It must visibly connect to the existing tomato plant, not float as detached decoration.
2. At the far right, let one fine curling pea tendril, accompanied by at most one small pea leaflet, trail a little below the same boundary into the open cream upper-right corner. Make this smaller and lighter than the left foliage overlap, about 4–7 mm. Keep it right of the title sprout and comfortably above/to the right of the title lettering. It must emerge naturally from the existing pea plant. Asymmetric and casual, not a matching corner ornament.

These new overlaps should be photorealistic with subtle soft contact shadows on the cream, in the same bright daylight as the existing strip. They may break the edge but MUST NOT touch, cover, crowd or displace any letter or the title sprout. Preserve lots of clear cream space. No additional new overlaps, no leafy frame or garland, no hanging fruit, no bigger vegetables entering the middle.

Retain the existing carrot frond overlap at bottom left unchanged. Preserve all existing vegetables, their arrangements, relative sizes, the pale warm sage timber backgrounds, lighting, crop textures and strip heights. Preserve the cream panel and ALL title/subtitle/byline typography exactly: 'The Vegetable Guru', 'Your at-a-glance growing companion', 'John Lennon', plus the existing two-leaf graphic sprout. Preserve the white YouTube sticker exactly: size, position, shadow, layering on top, gentle clockwise tilt, red play mark and text 'As seen on' / 'YouTube' / '@hackriculture'. This is ONLY a two-small-foliage-overlaps edit, not a redesign. Same complete flat front cover and portrait 185:240 proportions.
